subject.title: [Feature]: Catch up on missed inbound messages after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel missed-inbound catch-up contract now, and should Slack/Discord be the first provider-owned implementations?
rationale: Current main only has provider-specific iMessage recovery plus partial in-flight restart mitigations; a generic replay feature changes channel permissions, config defaults, ordering, and idempotency semantics.

options.title: Design a shared recovery contract
options.body: Add a typed SDK/plugin recovery seam first, then implement Slack and Discord with provider-owned cursors, dedupe, policy checks, and replay limits.

options.title: Land in-flight restart recovery first
options.body: Keep this issue open but prioritize #51620 and the queue/drain PRs before starting provider-history replay work.

options.title: Defer provider-history replay
options.body: Keep only current iMessage, Telegram, and queue-drain mitigations until maintainers have live Slack/Discord restart proof and a clearer default policy.

recommendation.title: Design a shared recovery contract
recommendation.body: Add a typed SDK/plugin recovery seam first, then implement Slack and Discord with provider-owned cursors, dedupe, policy checks, and replay limits.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision crosses gateway restart behavior, channel runtime contracts, and queue semantics where recent history points to this owner as the best current router.
